purpose: Prevent another optimizer from memorizing workload identity or a fixed baseline.
hard_requirements: At least three semantic-ready query families expose three or more candidates.
All bound performance sources passed their frozen acceptance protocols.
Both baseline and non-baseline singleton winners exist globally.
At least one three-or-more-candidate family has two different singleton winners across predeclared strata.
Governance changes at least one legal candidate set.
Bidirectional checkpoint reversal exists in development and real distributions.
failure_policy: Do not fit the multi-candidate optimizer. Add no performance-driven query template. Extend one already governance-frozen family and rerun this audit only after a separately frozen development measurement.
success_policy: Authorize implementation and grouped development validation of one unified multi-candidate optimizer; do not authorize a paper performance claim or access a new final holdout.
